I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands describedbelow are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

Allotments of land called Kajugaha Kumbura having followingmentioned extent and limitation in total extent of 0.5040 Hectareshown as Lots ‘A’ and ‘B’ in Amended Advance Tracing No. Gam/Watt/2013/122 and dated 29th May, 2013, prepared by theSuperintendent of Surveys situated in the Village of Nawammaharain Ragam Pattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Wattala in the District of Gampaha in Western Province:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Extent: 0.1020 HectareNorth: Kajugaha Kumbura claimed by Gamunu Force Base SriLanka Navy, Canal and Kajugaha Kumbura claimed by GamunuForce Base Sri Lanka Navy; East: Kajugaha Kumbura claimed byGamunu Force Base Sri Lanka Navy and Lot B; South: Lot B, Road(Pradeshiya Sabha) and Canal; West: Canal, Kajugaha Kumburaclaimed by Gamunu Force Base Sri Lanka Navy and Canal.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Kajugaha Kumbura – Extent: 0.4020 HectareNorth: Lot A (Canal) and Kajugaha Kumbura claimed by GamunuForce Base Sri Lanka Navy; East: Kajugaha Kumbura claimed byGamunu Force Base Sri Lanka Navy; South: Kajugaha Kumburaclaimed by Gamunu Force Base Sri Lanka Navy, Road (PradeshiyaSabha) and Lot A (Canal); West: Canal and Lot A (Canal).
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands.
